audience.text: Python developers building applications that process PDF documents, including those needing document authoring, conversion, redaction, and compliance checks.

capabilities.text: Create new PDFs or load existing ones from file paths, bytes, or streams; support context managers and round-trip serialization via to_bytes and to_stream.
capabilities.title: Create, load, and save PDF documents

capabilities.text: Add text, images, paths, rectangles, and tables to pages; control color, stroke, opacity, transforms, and graphics state blocks.
capabilities.title: Page layout and content authoring

capabilities.text: Extract text with region and artifact filtering, search and replace text, redact content, auto-link URLs, and highlight matches.
capabilities.title: Text extraction, search, and editing

capabilities.text: Extract tables as ExtractedTable objects with CSV export, and extract structured blocks (headings, paragraphs, lists) as JSON.
capabilities.title: Table and block extraction

capabilities.text: Add, read, export, and remove annotations; import/export bookmarks as JSON or CSV; inventory and validate links.
capabilities.title: Annotations, bookmarks, and links

capabilities.text: Render pages to PNG, TIFF, JPEG, or WebP; export pages as SVG with selectable text; create contact sheets and rasterized copies.
capabilities.title: Rendering and export to images and SVG

capabilities.text: Create, fill, flatten, and validate AcroForm fields; export form schemas as JSON Schema; batch-fill forms from CSV.
capabilities.title: Forms and validation

capabilities.text: Encrypt/decrypt with AES-256, sign with PAdES-LTA, embed fonts, validate PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X compliance, and sanitize documents.
capabilities.title: Security, signing, and compliance

limitations.text: Page rendering is a best-effort rasterizer without full overprint or PDF 2.0 imaging semantics.
PDF/A and PDF/UA validation are heuristic checks, not certification-grade; use external tools like veraPDF for formal compliance.
OCR and layout reflow are not implemented; text replacement does not reflow surrounding content.
SVG export flattens curves to polylines and writes text as glyph outlines, which renders exactly but is not selectable.
WOFF2 decoding and complex-text shaping require optional extras (woff2 and text-layout).
Public-key encryption supports RSA recipients only; key-agreement, password, and KEK types are rejected.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion without requiring a commercial license or external dependencies beyond cryptography and asn1crypto.
Supports batch workflows through low-code plugins like Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, Stamper, FormFiller, Encryptor, and Decryptor.
Provides tools for PDF compliance validation (PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X), sanitization, and font embedding to meet archival and accessibility requirements.
Facilitates text extraction, table detection, annotation management, and redaction for data extraction, review, and document cleanup workflows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python is an open-source, MIT-licensed Python library for creating, reading, editing, rendering, and validating PDF documents, targeting Python 3.11+.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported annotation subtypes for import from JSON is not fully enumerated in the facts.
Whether the bundled JPEG 2000 decoder supports all ISO 15444-1 subsets beyond packed packet headers is unclear.
The behavior of Document.concatenate_pages when source documents are modified after mapping is not specified.
Whether Document.compare_text handles bidirectional text or complex script shaping is not stated.
The exact set of fields included in Form.export_schema and Form.export_json_schema is not detailed.
Whether Document.fonts reports every font instance or only unique font definitions is ambiguous.
The handling of nested annotations (e.g., replies to replies) in export/import workflows is not clarified.
Whether Document.rasterized_copy preserves hidden layers or annotations when include_annotations=False is not explicit.

workflows.name: Create and save a PDF
workflows.text: Create a new PDF document, add an A4 page, insert text at coordinates, and save to disk using Document and PageSize APIs.

workflows.name: Load, inspect, and modify a PDF
workflows.text: Load an existing PDF from file, inspect page count and metadata, resize pages, and save changes using Document context manager and page APIs.

workflows.name: Export pages as images or ZIP
workflows.text: Render selected pages as images or package them into a ZIP archive with optional manifest using export_pages_zip and save_page_as_image methods.

workflows.name: Extract tables and text
workflows.text: Extract tables from specific pages, convert them to CSV, and extract text with region or artifact filtering.

workflows.name: Sanitize and validate a PDF
workflows.text: Sanitize a PDF to remove metadata, scripts, and hidden layers, then validate PDF/A, PDF/UA, or PDF/X compliance.

workflows.name: Batch process documents with plugins
workflows.text: Use low-code plugins like Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, and Stamper to process files, bytes, or streams in batch workflows.
